P1-CYCLE4-MED-001.rationale: The canonical test command's glob misses the top-level acceptance regression tests, so the gate never runs them.

P1-FINAL-HIGH-003.rationale: The PII scanner's allowlist skips a whole line that holds a placeholder address, so a real address beside it passes.

P2-FINAL-HIGH-001.rationale: The integration gate passes without provisioning or health-checking the real backends and pins no image digest.

P2-FINAL-HIGH-002.rationale: The agent sandbox is optional and mounts the worktree read-write, so the agent can write the repository's git metadata.

P2-FINAL-HIGH-003.rationale: Risk admission runs after the lease and the workspace exist, so a refused task has already caused side effects.

P2-FINAL-HIGH-004.rationale: Requests can act for another tenant, and organization creation needs no authentication.

P2-FINAL-HIGH-005.rationale: Authoritative references are stored without foreign keys or checksum checks, so records can point at the wrong or a missing object.

P2-FINAL-HIGH-006.rationale: A side effect recorded as pending is replayed after a crash instead of being reconciled, so commits, pushes or pull requests repeat.

P2-FINAL-HIGH-007.rationale: A commit the agent creates on a detached head is not detected, because only created refs and git-directory writes are checked.

P2-FINAL-HIGH-008.rationale: No production composition root exists: the shared driver hard-codes test doubles instead of injecting the real adapters.

P2-FINAL-HIGH-009.rationale: The pilot manifest verifier trusts self-declared data, so a fabricated complete manifest passes.

P2-FINAL-MED-001.rationale: The persistence tests run on one in-process connection, so they cannot show PostgreSQL's concurrency and advisory-lock behaviour.

P2-FINAL-MED-002.rationale: An already expired token is used, and every HTTP 403 is treated as an expired credential.

P2-FINAL-MED-003.rationale: Most of the required spans have no runtime call site, so the audit trail misses them.

P2-FINAL-MED-004.rationale: The app layer calls repositories and sequences the workflow directly, and the import scanner misses the pattern.

P2-FINAL-MED-005.rationale: The phase report claims more than its evidence shows and names a head SHA other than the one reviewed.

P2-FINAL-MED-006.rationale: The pilot rehearsal is a tabletop document whose faults have no executable test.

P2-REREVIEW-MED-NEW-001.rationale: The object-store backend is only health-checked; no artifact path stores or reads through it in the gate.

P2-REREVIEW-MED-NEW-002.rationale: The real-backend vertical-slice suite is not a required suite, so removing it leaves the gate green.
